description: RWX is a hosted CI/CD platform with remote sandboxes and content-based caching for software development workflows. It lets teams launch runs, inspect results, manage secrets, and support coding-agent workflows around CI and sandbox environments.
summary: RWX exposes an authenticated REST API at `cloud.rwx.com/mint/api`, a first-party `rwx` CLI, and an MCP server served locally through that CLI; all documented developer access uses RWX-issued bearer tokens obtained interactively via `rwx login` or via PAT/service-account tokens.
